newTests.name: waits for the active split editor save before deleting its note
does not resurrect a workspace cleared on sign-out when the same account returns
does not delete an active note or the rest of a selection when saving fails
waits for a manual save even when the draft is unchanged
cancels single deletion and keeps the draft when the pending manual save fails
never renders the previous account while the next account is hydrating
keeps the in-memory editor usable and warns if session storage is unavailable
hides the old workspace immediately when the provider changes users before the auth hook catches up
can delete a different note without waiting for the active editor
does not send any online deletes when preparation fails
keeps saved and failed drafts intact until the account is known, then restores the open tabs
does not overwrite a saved workspace when storage reads fail but writes remain available
waits for an active save before queuing a bulk selection
does not expose or persist the previous account when users change
keeps both open notes through a temporary null user and displays the restored active note
